dedupe_keys.name: earthresourceml data transfer standard for mineral occurrences mines and mining activity

description: An XML data standard for exchanging information on mineral occurrences, mines and mining. The EarthResourceML site says the model describes mineral occurrences, their commodities, resources and reserves, and mines and mining activities with their production of concentrates, refined products and waste. Version 2.0, released in October 2013, uses GML 3.2, SWE Common 2 and GeoSciML 3.2 and comes with HTML documentation, a UML model and XML schemas; EarthResourceML-Lite version 2.0.1, released in October 2018, is a simplified schema for WMS and WFS map services with views of occurrences, commodities, mines, mining activity and mine waste. All are free downloads. Coverage is international, used by geological surveys. Caveats: the site is hosted by Geoscience Australia with copyright CGI 2017, and no licence is named on the page read. For simulation it gives a common format to merge national mine and deposit datasets into one supply model. A related catalogue record is the OGC WaterML 2 standard.
